task: Single-fleet search until all 17 occupied cells have been hit
scope: Descriptive, in-distribution finite-catalog demonstration; not competitive Battleship or optimality evidence
selection: Random uses an independent seeded stream. Other policies use greedy scores, then higher hit probability, then ascending cell index; EFE uses minimum G, not sampling q.
summary: All 16 paired cases per catalog size; mean, median, range and mean paired difference from greedy hit. No significance tests or population confidence claims.
exclusions: None. Any failed or unfinished search fails generation.
